items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He played most of these little clubs with you, didn't he? ... All of them.

ctx.x: Who was the trumpet player then? Lawrence. Lawrence. Yeah. Lawrence. Yeah. That must have been a long time ago. It was quite a while, in both places. And the Lurch is over in the Humming Inn. Yes, the old Humming Inn. Because I worked for Lurchin, a long time, small, long, and many years old in Hymn. Because the day that comes to the Lurchin, I'm a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of an arrangement to build their own business business business business business business business business business…
Your favorite trumpet player at this time was Ronas? Yeah. He played most of these little clubs with you, didn't he? All of them.
All of them. And then? Just later I stopped playing, and he quit too.
What was the first band you played in? The first real band?

I'm reading, reading, reading. The first band I played in. I just remember it was, I believe it was Ambrose Power. Ambrose Power. Yeah. Lawrence took his uncle. I played, I played then with them down at Del Cron.
Was he a valve trombone player or a slide? A valve. Valve at that time. Yeah. So we went on down there playing on there.
